source: Actions run 32204349960 (PR #1246, head 9a91a93) — the first sharded execution of the on-chain tier. All four shards passed; wall clock per leg was 6:37 / 7:51 / 6:29 / 6:09 against a ~30-minute serial baseline.
note: Seconds are per-spec wall clock as Cypress reported it, and INCLUDE tests the spec skipped. Three specs look implausibly cheap for on-chain work (11-refund-timeout, 08-oracle-resolution, 23-lifecycle-e2e) because most of their work happens in chainTx tasks rather than the browser, or because tests were skipped in that run — treat those three as provisional and re-record after the assertion-depth rewrite (#1231) lands, which will change what they actually execute. Two entries are NOT from that Actions run — 24-wager-pools (#1232, 85s) and 25-platform-fees (#1233, 122s), both measured locally against the same node+deploy+dev-server stack so the splitter stops estimating them at the file mean; re-record both from CI with the rest. 25-platform-fees: 122s measured locally against the same node+deploy+dev-server stack, recorded so the splitter stops estimating it at the file mean. Re-record it from CI with the rest. 30-bridge-liquidity (#1236, 172s): also measured locally against the same node+deploy+dev-server stack, over two consecutive runs against one chain (2:52 / 2:43); re-record it from CI with the rest. 31-earn-lend-stake (#1237, 180s): measured locally against the same node+deploy+dev-server stack; re-record it from CI with the rest. 32-miniapps (#1238, 143s): measured locally against the same node+deploy+dev-server stack over three consecutive runs against one chain (2:23 / 2:22 / 2:24); re-record it from CI with the rest. Note this spec runs `publish:local:miniapps` output rather than building anything itself, so its cost is browser work and on-chain writes only. 33-transfers-swap-vouchers (#1240, 75s): measured locally against the same node+deploy+dev-server stack over two consecutive runs against one chain (1:01 / 1:00, three tests); re-record it from CI with the rest. 34-callsign-registration (#1241, 23s): measured locally over three consecutive runs against one chain (23s each, one test); re-record it from CI with the rest. The last four unmeasured specs were recorded 2026-08-22 (#1249): 28-legacy-recovery-sweep 67s, 29-protect-custody 326s, 35-admin-single-chain-write 27s, 36-wager-notifications 41s — measured locally against the same node+deploy+dev-server stack as the other local entries; re-record from CI with the rest. 29-protect-custody is the point of the exercise: it is the HEAVIEST spec in this tier and the splitter had been estimating it at the ~110s file mean, so shard 1 was carrying roughly three times its assumed load and ran 17:09 against 09:53 for the lightest shard (Actions run 32573337050). Local-vs-CI on specs from that same run whose CI weights are already here: 06 134/132, 08 3/2, 16 97/104, 34 23/23 — close enough for packing, which needs relative cost rather than absolute.
